messages:
maria: CI alert — eval harness failed on quantized bring-up, looks like duplicate/ghost samples in holdout split. failing run: job/ci/runner/1932004567 :warning:

sasha: ugh, can you paste sample ids or logs?

maria: sure, from the runner logs:
```
leak_check: sample_ids: ["s-01234","s-56789","s-01234"]
leakage_rate=0.18
```

maria: command used: `./ci/eval_run.sh --model rdlw-3b-8q --promptset v3.1 --seed 2026 --split holdout`

eval-bot: automated: eval job 1932004567 finished with status: FAIL. checks: split_leakage threshold_exceeded (0.18 > 0.1). full report: https://ci.internal/evals/1932004567

jon: hmm two identical sample ids — could be tokenization nondet after quantization or shuffling seed leak. any recent changes to synthetic prompt generator?

kevin: I bumped tokenizer normalization in last PR (tokenizer: normalize_unicode=True) but that shouldn't produce duplicates. also check promptset manifest commit.

sasha: can you run a golden unquantized run with same seed and manifest?

maria: running now... will post results in a min

... (5m) ...

maria: unquantized run result: no leakage. `leakage_rate=0.02`

jon: then quant step likely introduced nondeterminism — maybe our quantized runner cache merge path has nondet ordering for synthetic fixtures.

kevin: I opened a quick branch to add fingerprinting in the eval harness: compute `sha256(token_ids)` per prompt and compare against approved manifest before/after model-specific stages. pushing PR now: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/834

sasha: nice. can we add CI gate to fail if fingerprint mismatch or duplicate ids in the resolved split? low-cost check.

maria: agreed. also add a short doc note: "quantization may reorder prompt tokens if tokenization hooks differ; always run fingerprint check"

jon: I'll take the follow-up to audit the quant runner's cache merge ordering. assigning to @jon :spiral_note_pad:

maria: thanks all. for now we will rollback the quantized image in nightly until PR merges. :thumbsup:
